subject: aftf
title: AFI.TF.------STF.
description: Diagram in CMBA-20, the second on book p264. (C)AFTF (affinity transfer) is crossed with STF (source transfer). AFTF outputs to STF (the crossing) and MT-INFO (multi-information). A further branch from the main line leads to (P)TRS (the point of idea completion of transition). MT-INFO then leads to AFI-DY, which branches to ASP-ES (aspect essence); ASP-ES in turn branches to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). ASP-ES has a *dashed* edge to (R)INT (the reality of intention).
